source_lock.rule: No knowledge claim may enter core KB without a source_ref resolved through this manifest/index.
source_lock.prescribed_textbook: B. S. Grewal, Higher Engineering Mathematics, 36th Edition, Khanna Publishers, 2010
source_lock.out_of_syllabus_policy: Use only the portions that map to the current R25 unit. Extra textbook material remains supporting or omitted.
source_lock.answer_policy: Textbook exercise mathematics (numbers, signs, equations, matrices and conditions) is preserved and independently checked. Awkward grammar or punctuation may be lightly cleaned for readability without changing meaning. Appendix answers remain separate printed checks; verified mathematical mismatches are explicitly flagged in amber and are never silently reconciled.
source_lock.copyright_policy: Raw commercial textbook screenshots are not copied into the public workspace. KB records page/image provenance only.
source_lock.textbook_fidelity_policy: For prescribed-book theory, retain the supplied textbook wording and sequence as closely as practical, filtered only to the R25 syllabus. Worked textbook examples are kept as collapsible dropdowns. PankusDesk additions, if any, must be visibly separated from textbook-derived text.
source_lock.chapter_end_question_policy: R25-relevant textbook problem sets, including section-end sets such as Problems 28.4, are published set-by-set on the Textbook Questions page and linked at the same logical point in the theory flow where the prescribed book places them. Full PankusDesk solutions are supplied; printed appendix answers remain separate checks.
source_lock.class_note_policy: Dated notebook records live on the dedicated Priyanka's Class Notes page for the unit. They are not mixed into the cumulative textbook Text page. Overlap with the prescribed book is retained only on the class-notes page as class history; verified notebook slips are called out transparently rather than silently propagated.
